summary: The PR #14 'Lint And Build' failure in lib/venue/staff-management.service.ts is a genuine schema/type gap, not stale generated types. The tables venue_crew_members and venue_team_contractors and the RPC get_staff_dashboard_stats exist in no active migration and in no generated type: they are defined only in supabase/migrations/archive/enhanced_staff_management_schema.sql (tables at lines 29 and 55, function at line 304) and in supabase/migrations_backup/. docs/engineering/generated/database-objects.md, the database agent's own generated object map, already classifies all three with source supabase/migrations/archive/enhanced_staff_management_schema.sql, i.e. archived rather than active. The database lane therefore did NOT author a migration to create them, because the repository's own architecture maps name different canonical destinations and re-creating these objects would resurrect a surface that those maps exist to retire. lib/venue/staff-management.service.ts is venue-owned and was not edited. The database lane needs the venue domain to remove or repoint the dead surface; the retirement decision is the venue domain's to make, not the database lane's.
